title: Critical Analysis
intent: formative · Intellectual Depth (Thinking) · click through the process
statement: Move past summarising to judging a source: test its central claim, its hidden assumptions, and whether the evidence actually holds.

steps.title: Identify the core claim
steps.text: Find the single main point you are being asked to accept. Everything else is scaffolding around it.

steps.title: Surface the assumptions
steps.text: Name the beliefs that must be true for the claim to stand — especially the ones left unstated.

steps.title: Weigh the evidence
steps.text: Is the support sufficient, relevant and unbiased? Ask what data would contradict the claim.

steps.title: Judge the reasoning
steps.text: Check the step from evidence to claim. A true premise can still carry a broken inference.

steps.title: Form your verdict
steps.text: Decide how far the claim earns your acceptance, and say exactly where it is strong and where it is weak.

feedForward.text: Now do it on your own reading: quote the claim, list two assumptions, and name the single weakest link in the argument.
